The '''Dance of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|Slave]] [[Gender/Legends|Girl]]''' was a raunchy dance that a 10-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] old [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] performed in front of a large audience at a dance performance at the [[Alderaan Select Academy for Young Ladies]]. [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] enjoyed it although few, if any, others in the audience did.
